shop.digitalPrintQualityCaption: High-resolution download supports prints up to approximately 18×24 in (vertical) at 300 DPI.

pdp.downloadHint: Opens a secure link to save the high-resolution file. Use the preview above for web and quick sharing.
pdp.accordionShippingBody: Each order is printed after checkout—allow 3–5 business days for production plus transit time. Tracking is sent when your package leaves our partner lab. International delivery may incur duties.
pdp.accordionReturnsBody: Because pieces are made to order, returns are limited to damage in transit or print defects—contact us within 14 days with photos of the packaging and item. Color variation up to 10% versus your screen is normal for giclée and canvas.
pdp.accordionCareBody: Handle framed and canvas works with clean, dry hands. Dust lightly with a soft microfiber cloth; avoid household cleaners on the print surface. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve color for years in hospitality environments.
pdp.accordionDigitalLicenseBody: This complimentary file is for your restaurant’s own marketing and in-venue use. Redistribution, resale, or use as a standalone commercial stock asset outside your brand is not permitted unless we grant written permission.
pdp.accordionDigitalFileBody: The download is a hires JPEG at 6656×9984 px (portrait). That pixel count supports crisp vertical posters up to roughly 18×24 inches at 300 DPI; you can crop or rotate for other layouts if needed. Colors may vary slightly between screens, labs, and papers—request a proof from your printer when matching brand-critical hues.
pdp.checkoutHint: Online checkout is not available yet—we will notify you when ordering opens.

hero.headline: The Digital Curator: Gastronomy-inspired art for every wall
hero.description: Imagery shaped by restaurants, cafés, and bars—and open to anyone who wants it framed or hung at full scale. Complimentary digital downloads include high-resolution JPEGs suited to bold vertical posters around 18×24 inches at 300 DPI.
hero.subtitle: Print-on-demand and downloads with a kitchen-and-bar point of view—from venue walls to framed pieces at home.
